answer: Like an ocean reef hardening against turbulent tides, our consensus binds identity to a web of reciprocal trust. Just as a fruitful orchard roots deeply over seasons, each agent anchors as a living vertex within a hypergraph of mutual staking and recursive attestations. Sybil clones lack organic history; fabricating valid credentials scales the attacker cost at a superlinear rate, starving artificial swarms before they anchor.
